blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — The Bohol provincial government has donated a province-owned lot at the foot of Mt. Banat-i in Tagbilaran City to the Supreme Court of the Philippines for a new Hall of Justice. Gov. Aris Aumentado signed the Deed of Donation on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026, formalizing the province’s donation of the property for the planned judicial facility. The Sangguniang Panlalawigan earlier passed Resolution No. 2026-1252, authorizing Aumentado to sign the deed and confirming the province’s previous donation.
